text: THE SITE FOOTER MEETS DBIM 3.0 AND CARRIES EVERY LINK IN THE LIVE dosje.gov.in FOOTER. Every icon and all three organisation lines are now inclusive white, and the National Emblem ships at 89 KB instead of 196 KB with the same geometry. Help opens a new Help page (file formats, screen reader access, accessibility, FAQs) instead of Contact Us, and new Citizen Charter, Cookies and Visitor Analytics pages give the live footer's remaining links a destination. Links neither the live footer nor DBIM or GIGW asks for were removed: MyGov, Open Government Data, Digital India and CPGRAMS from Related Links, and the Accessibility Statement link. The footer's Total Visits now shows the Department's published figure, the same one the Visitor Analytics page shows. The documentation page scores the footer 100 / 100 with four recorded deviations (Material Symbols icons, the 16px pin, the 16px column headings), states Archives as optional, and sets every live link against this footer. The Figma master's credits now sit flush right on both desktop variants.
